season.evidence: Stored Jul-Sep; hiking-guide pages say July to October with snow the main hazard; Mountaineers ran it late September. Few Peakbagger ascents.

track.why: Only one route stored. Sep 13 2025 single-peak ascent from the climbers path to the summit; passes the ridge-junction pin and reaches the summit, report describes the Barclay path past Gunn Lake. Start is 310 m from the pin (WTA position matches our pin; the climbers path starts on the spur), so it misses the 300 m rule by a hair.

otherTracksConsidered.why: July 7 link-up with Gunn, Gunn East, Peak 5763 and Tailgunner.

facts.text: Partway up the steep forested section the path can seem to stop at a gully; the continuing bootpath leaves to the climber's left, and the gully itself goes only at greater difficulty.
Several parallel bootpaths lead to the summit; a short downclimb on the way is easy class 2 or a bit harder class 3, as you prefer.
In early July the creek can be crossed by hopping closely spaced rocks, and drinking water above is only slow drips off snow patches in flat spots.

notes: Trailhead pin 47.7923,-121.4592 equals the position printed by the hiking-trail association; no move.
